channels.name: Direct operations
channels.text: KMSC staff on KMSC phones. Our anchors, our hubs, the whole spine in-house.

channels.name: Partner operators
channels.runs: The partner, fully independent, on our phones
channels.text: Their floor, their people, their uploads. Our phones under MDM, our gate, our review.

channels.name: Delivery partners
channels.text: Their sites, their people, our standards. Phones set per site at central planning.

spine.text: Every wearer, every channel. The site nominates, KMSC activates. No paper, no device.
Created by KMSC, in their name. Never shared, never recycled. A flag lands on a person.
Youssef Medhat's team sees every video before the client does. Keep, flag, or delete.

spine.step: Pay on accepted hours net of fraud flags
spine.text: Flagged hours come off the top after the month-end audit. The way the company is paid.

shared: Whoever runs the floor, the spine is ours. No spine, no payment, in every agreement.

questions.q: Will the owner run the floor with their own people, on our phones?
Do we have a Portfolio Manager and anchors in that city?
Does the site have fiber, or a hub within reach?
Can a partner staff it and deliver hours to our standards?
